name: Alphawest
summary: Perth IT services & ISP ('Leaders in IT'; orig. Edcom Pty Ltd 1986, later Sydney HQ); ASX-listed 2004, taken over by Optus (SingTel) Nov 2005, brand retired 2013 (ALPHAWEST SERVICES PTY LTD, ACN 009 196 347).

events.details: Perth internet access + IT services; traces to Edcom Pty Ltd (Perth, 1986, PC sales/support). Acquired by Solution 6 (2000), management buyout (2003), ASX-listed (2004).

Optus (SingTel) takeover offer Jul 2005 (~$26M); completed and delisted from ASX Nov 2005. Continued as an Optus IT-services subsidiary (now Macquarie Park, NSW per ABR); Alphawest brand retired 2013.
